caption: The drawing features a single shoe with a short, curved heel and elongated toe. The shoe is primarily colored in shades of light green with white, ornamental floral or brocade patterns decorating its surface. The flap across the front of the shoe is rendered in the same green and white brocade pattern as the rest of the upper. The shoe’s inner lining is light brown, and the sole is dark. The heel is similarly light brown with darker shading for dimensionality, and it has a curved, slightly flared shape. The shoe is outlined in black with some additional shading to define its form. Beneath the shoe, handwritten text reads: "Brocade Shoes 18th Century." The background of the drawing is plain and cream-colored, with no additional objects or designs present.
title: Shoe
